links.comparator_used: Radiologists interpreting head NCCT examinations without AI assistance (phase 1) versus with the AI triage and notification system (phase 2)
links.outcome: Report turnaround time for ICH-positive examinations, and diagnostic performance for ICH detection
links.effect: Mean turnaround 147.1 min without AI vs 149.9 min with AI (p = .11). Accuracy 99.5% vs 99.2%, sensitivity 98.6% vs 98.9%, PPV 99.0% vs 97.5%, NPV 99.7% vs 99.7% (all p > .01).
links.tradeoff: Specificity was significantly lower with AI (99.3% vs 99.8%, p = .004). The comparison was between sequential phases, not randomized.
links.quote: An AI triage system for ICH detection did not improve radiologists' diagnostic performance or report turnaround times.

design_hint: AI triage and notification for radiologists, compared with and without AI assistance
